title: Affine depth two boundary property
statement:
theorem affine_depth_two_boundary_property
    (A : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsNoetherianRing A] (W : (Spec A).Opens)
    (hboundary : ∀ x : Spec A, x ∉ W →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth
        (R := (Spec A).presheaf.stalk x) ((Spec A).presheaf.stalk x))
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) [Module.Finite A M] :
    ∀ x : Spec A, x ∉ W →
      ∃ hfinite : Module.Finite ((Spec A).presheaf.stalk x)
          (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u})
            (tilde (ModuleCat.of A (Module.Dual A (Module.Dual A M)))).val.presheaf x),
        letI := hfinite
        (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := (Spec A).presheaf.stalk x)
          (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u})
            (tilde (ModuleCat.of A (Module.Dual A (Module.Dual A M)))).val.presheaf x)

proof.text: Identify the stalk of tilde(Hom_A(Hom_A(M,A),A)) with the double dual of the finite stalk of tilde M, using the localization-Hom comparison.
The local ring is Noetherian and the two local duals are finite. Apply the local dual-depth theorem to the first dual with the assumed depth-two bound for the structure stalk.

Transport finiteness along the inverse linear equivalence. For arbitrary ideals I ≤ J and a linear equivalence, I-depth of the source is at most J-depth of the target: transport maximal-ideal multiples in the infinite-depth case and regular sequences in the finite case. Specialize this proved helper to the maximal ideal and the inverse stalk comparison, and compose depth inequalities to obtain the boundary conclusion.

proof_origin.place: Tags 01HV(7), 0583, 0AV5(2); actual finite double-dual repair of the model used in 0EY6

statement_change.what: The original theorem quantified over arbitrary coherent H and was false: over k[x,y,z], with W=D(x) union D(y), tilde(A/(x)) has depth one at (x,y) although the structure stalk has depth two. Replace H by the associated sheaf of the actual finite double dual Hom_A(Hom_A(M,A),A), exactly as required by reviewer X-7ea0b.

citers.note: The unchanged existence assertion now constructs the actual double dual of global sections of the coherent extension; finiteness and restriction preservation are established before using the corrected helper.

old_proof.text: Use a finite free presentation of the double dual kernel and regular-pair injectivity; Nakayama gives depth two.
